scripts.build: prisma generate && tsc -b && tsc -p tsconfig.api.json --pretty false && vite build
scripts.build:offline: tsc -b && tsc -p tsconfig.api.json --pretty false && node scripts/build-offline.mjs
scripts.test: node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/http-timeout.test.mjs tests/media-upload.test.mjs tests/rate-limit.test.mjs tests/customer-isolation.test.mjs tests/wishlist-optimistic.test.mjs tests/vercel-routing.test.mjs tests/order-transactions.test.mjs tests/payment-order-state.test.mjs tests/csrf.test.mjs tests/api-errors.test.mjs tests/password-recovery.test.mjs tests/email-verification.test.mjs
scripts.format: prettier --write src server api scripts tests prisma/seed.mjs "*.{ts,js,mjs,cjs,json}" .prettierrc.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src server api scripts tests prisma/seed.mjs "*.{ts,js,mjs,cjs,json}" .prettierrc.json
